The emitter is a computed tally, not a fixed number: `git -C /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin show bcba8924:tools/mutate-and-run.sh | sed -n '2125p'` -> `printf 'MUTATE_SELFTEST: %s/%s pass\n' "$((cases - failed))" "$cases"`. 67/67 is the round-8-era reading (`plans/round-8-record-draft.md:82`, `.ufo` ledger `corpus/knowledge/fleet-kill-rate-ledger.md:341`), so the fix dates the old count and states the current one on the same line. Independent cross-check of the same stale count: round-51 reader T51W2Read08 (record `.ufo/waves/round-52/w1/T52W1Corr08.json`, finding 1).

replacements.evidence: SKILL.md:1015 ('three readings per case') and the rule rows at SKILL.md:1033-1035 define only `current`/`stale`/`drift`, and `stale` requires 'the recorded revision is an ancestor of `refs/heads/<branch>`' (`git -C ... show bcba8924:SKILL.md | sed -n '1015p;1033,1035p'`). A non-ancestor rewrite of the branch tip matches none of the three; fixture built at CAND0 (never the lane): `D=$(mktemp -d -p $S fx2.XXXX); git -C $D init -q; commit one; commit two (the recorded revision); git -C $D reset -q --hard one; commit three` -> recorded=d328f223..., tip=5f7759f3..., recorded_pin=81db67b6, tipblob=1875add4; `git merge-base --is-ancestor <recorded> <tip>` -> ancestor=no; `git status --porcelain` -> 0 lines; therefore `current` fails (pin != tip blob), `stale` fails (not an ancestor), `drift` fails (live == tip blob, porcelain clean): current=no stale=no drift=no. Same gap recorded by round-51 reader T51W2Read08 (`.ufo/evidence/round-51/coldread/reads/T51W2Read08.md:13`; record `.ufo/waves/round-52/w1/T52W1Corr08.json`, finding 2), which also verdicts the three rule rows themselves as holding — so the note qualifies the completeness claim without rewriting a rule. The citation names the rule in force at CAND0: `git -C ... show bcba8924:corpus/knowledge/fleet-kill-rate-ledger.md | sed -n '420p'` -> ER-jj, branch tip `refs/heads/<branch>`, canonical rule `SKILL.md:1027-1035`.

The sentence at SKILL.md:1141-1144 carries two claims under one citation: D7 reproduces kimi's `slice(0, 6)` cap, and D8 is the assert-blind threshold. At CAND0 the cited range holds only the second: `git -C /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin show bcba8924:corpus/knowledge/mutation-case-kumitate-claims.md | sed -n '285,291p'` -> 'E2 — new measured shape: the assert-blind threshold (D8) ...'.
